name: Reservoir & Dam
summary: Impounds elevated headwater behind a concrete gravity dam, providing gravitational potential energy, filtered submerged intake, emergency isolation, and flood spillway bypass.

name: Water Conveyance
summary: Transfers pressurized water from the dam intake through headrace and rock-lined pressure tunnel past the surge tank down the steel penstock to the main inlet valve.

name: Turbine
summary: Distributes pressurized water 360 degrees through spiral casing, stay vanes, and pivoting guide vanes onto the mixed-flow Francis runner, converting fluid energy into shaft torque before draft-tube pressure recovery.

name: Generator
summary: Vertical 24-pole salient-pole synchronous generator converting shaft rotation into three-phase AC electricity at 250 rpm (50 Hz), supported by tilting-pad bearings, static exciter, and closed-loop coolers.

name: Electrical Transmission
summary: Routes 11 kV three-phase power from generator terminals via isolated-phase busbars and synchronizing breaker to the step-up transformer, outdoor switchyard, and high-voltage grid lines.

name: Discharge
summary: Returns decelerated turbine discharge through submerged draft tube outlet piers and tailrace channel into the downstream river with 100% water mass conservation.
